caption: The flow starts at zero at a free edge, grows along the wall, and its resultant acts through the shear centre. In the worked example q at the junction is 31.25 N/mm and e is 22.5 mm.

spec.title: From free edge to shear centre
spec.aria: A downward block diagram runs from a free edge where q is zero, through the build-up of shear flow along the wall, to the resultant vertical force of 5 kN and the shear-centre offset of 22.5 mm.
